content: भविष्यत् {%a.%} (-ती|-न्ती|{%f.%}) About to be, become or come to pass, future. --{%n.%} The future time. .{@-आक्षेपः@} .²1 denying the occurrence of a possible future event. .²2 a kind of Alaṅkāra or figure of speech; सोऽयं भविष्यदाक्षेपः प्रागेवातिमनस्विनी . कदाचिदपराधोऽस्य भावीत्येवमरुन्द्ध यत् .. <ls>Kāv. 2. 126</ls>. .{@-कालः@} futurity. .{@-वक्तृ, -वादिन्@} {%a.%} predicting future events, prophesying.
